preconditions.description: The size of the broom n is between 2 and 300,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v, _ in edges)
preconditions.description: Each vertex u and v in the edges is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, str) and len(x) == 1 and 'a' <= x <= 'z' for _, _, x in edges)
preconditions.description: Each letter x in the edges is a lowercase Latin letter.

preconditions.expression: 1 in {u for u, _, _ in edges} or 1 in {v for _, v, _ in edges}
preconditions.description: Vertex 1 is the root of the broom.

postconditions.description: The minimum possible size of the broom after simplification is between 1 and n inclusive.
The integer p to choose for simplification is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: min_broom_size == min([size_of_broom_after_simplification(p) for p in range(1, n + 1)])
postconditions.description: The minimum possible size of the broom is the smallest size obtained by simplifying the language with any p.

postconditions.expression: p == min([p for p in range(1, n + 1) if size_of_broom_after_simplification(p) == min_broom_size])
postconditions.description: The integer p is the smallest value that results in the minimum possible size of the broom.
